scene: crouching on the pavement at night, reaching for one grey glove dropped on the stoop steps

intro.ko: 올리브 파카와 검정 데님에 회색 울 소품을 맞췄다. 무릎에 여유 있는 데님과 끈 부츠는 몸을 낮출 때도 편하다.
intro.en: Grey wool accessories sit against an olive parka and black denim. Room at the knee and firmly laced boots help when crouching.
intro.de: Graue Wollaccessoires ergänzen den olivgrünen Parka und die schwarze Jeans. Platz am Knie und fest geschnürte Stiefel erleichtern das Hinhocken.

deck.ko: 떨어뜨린 장갑 한 짝을 주우려 쪼그려 앉은 밤의 파카 차림.
deck.en: A parka night, crouched low to rescue the one that got away.
deck.de: Ein Parka-Abend: in der Hocke, um den einen Ausreißer wieder einzusammeln.

copy.pull: ONE GLOVE DOWN, ONE TO GO.

tip.ko: 장갑은 벗으면 바로 파카 주머니 깊숙이 넣어야 한 짝만 잃어버리지 않아요.
tip.en: Push gloves deep into a parka pocket the moment they come off, so you never lose just one.
tip.de: Handschuhe gleich nach dem Ausziehen tief in die Parkatasche stecken – so geht nie einer allein verloren.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

howToWear.ko: 파카 지퍼를 가슴까지 열어 니트를 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Unzip the parka to the chest to reveal the knit.
howToWear.de: Den Parka bis zur Brust öffnen, damit der Strick sichtbar wird.

howToWear.ko: 검정 골지 니트로 올리브 파카 안쪽을 차분하게 받친다.
howToWear.en: Set the olive parka against a simple black rib knit.
howToWear.de: Zum olivgrünen Parka einen schlichten schwarzen Rippstrickpullover tragen.

howToWear.ko: 쪼그릴 때 무릎이 당기지 않는 스트레이트 핏을 고른다.
howToWear.en: Choose straight legs that leave room at the knee when crouching.
howToWear.de: Gerade Beine mit Bewegungsfreiheit am Knie wählen.

products.spec: black hiking boots with grey laces

howToWear.ko: 하이킹 부츠 끈을 조여 계단에서도 뒤꿈치를 잡아 준다.
howToWear.en: Tie the hiking boots snugly to keep the heel in place on steps.
howToWear.de: Die Wanderstiefel fest schnüren, damit die Ferse auf Stufen Halt hat.

howToWear.en: Cover the ears even with the hood down.
howToWear.de: Die Ohren auch bei heruntergelassener Kapuze bedecken.

howToWear.ko: 파카 깃 사이로 목도리 끝을 내려 보온한다.
howToWear.en: Let the scarf ends fall between the parka lapels for warmth.
howToWear.de: Die Schalenden zwischen den offenen Parkakanten hängen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 바짓단이 올라가도 발목을 덮을 길이로 신는다.
howToWear.en: Wear them high enough to cover the ankle as the jeans rise.
howToWear.de: Die Socken so hoch tragen, dass sie auch bei hochrutschender Jeans den Knöchel bedecken.

products.spec: heather grey wool gloves, exactly one matching pair based on the dropped glove

howToWear.ko: 외출 직전 장갑 한 켤레를 챙겨 손을 보온한다.
howToWear.en: Take both gloves before heading out to keep your hands warm.
howToWear.de: Vor dem Rausgehen beide Handschuhe einstecken.
